t: 印度和中国骑士的马斯克由詹姆斯六世和一世的侍从在汉普顿法院出演.
te: The Masque of Indian and China Knights is performed by courtiers of James VI and I at Hampton Court.
dz: 印度和中国骑士的马斯克由詹姆斯六世和一世的侍从在汉普顿法院出演.
de: The Masque of Indian and China Knights is performed by courtiers of James VI and I at Hampton Court.

te: Samuel de Champlain encounters the mouth of the Saint John River, site of Reversing Falls and the present-day city of S…
dz: 塞缪尔·德·尚普兰遭遇了圣约翰河口,雷弗辛瀑布和现今的加拿大新不伦瑞克圣约翰市.
de: Samuel de Champlain encounters the mouth of the Saint John River, site of Reversing Falls and the present-day city of Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada.

t: 一支由奥兰治部队莫里斯所率领的包围荷兰和英国军队,斯卢伊斯的西班牙驻军投降.
te: a besieging Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange forces the Spanish garrison of Sluis to capitulate.
dz: 八十年战争:一支由奥兰治部队莫里斯所率领的包围荷兰和英国军队,斯卢伊斯的西班牙驻军投降.
de: Eighty Years War: a besieging Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange forces the Spanish garrison of Sluis to capitulate.

t: Guru Granth Sahib由Guru Arjan完全编译并完成.
te: The Guru Granth Sahib is fully compiled and completed by Guru Arjan.
dz: Guru Granth Sahib由Guru Arjan完全编译并完成.
de: The Guru Granth Sahib is fully compiled and completed by Guru Arjan.

te: Adi Granth, now known as Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture of Sikhs, is first installed at Harmandir Sahib.
dz: 阿迪·格兰斯(Adi Granth),现名"古鲁·格兰斯·萨希布"(Guru Granth Sahib)是锡克教的圣经,最早被安装于哈曼地尔·萨希布.
de: Adi Granth, now known as Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture of Sikhs, is first installed at Harmandir Sahib.

t: 开普勒超新星是银河系内观测到的最新超新星.
te: Kepler's Supernova is the most recent supernova to be observed within the Milky Way.
dz: 开普勒超新星是银河系内观测到的最新超新星.
de: Kepler's Supernova is the most recent supernova to be observed within the Milky Way.

t: 开普勒的"超新星"在奥菲乌丘斯星座被观测到.
te: Kepler's Supernova is observed in the constellation of Ophiuchus.
dz: 开普勒的"超新星"在奥菲乌丘斯星座被观测到.
de: Kepler's Supernova is observed in the constellation of Ophiuchus.
